name: Md Mojahid
heroDescription: CSE student, 4th semester — building AI-powered products that actually ship. From LMS platforms to automation systems, I turn ideas into real software.
aboutDescription: I'm Md Mojahid — a CSE student from India with a dangerous mix of curiosity and code. While most students just study, I build: AI-powered platforms, automation systems, YouTube channels, and SaaS products. Currently obsessed with making AI accessible to everyone.

projects.title: AI-Powered LMS
projects.description: Full learning management system with AI mentor, course enrollment, video access, student dashboards, and teacher admin panel. Built to scale.

projects.title: Nexora Channel
projects.description: Faceless YouTube channel for Indian audiences — AI, tech, psychology & human behavior. Retention-engineered Hinglish scripts with full production bibles.

projects.title: This Portfolio
projects.description: Bold black-orange portfolio site. Custom cursor, particle systems, scroll-reveal animations, glitch effects, and a character that makes recruiters stop scrolling.

process.title: Understand
process.description: Deep dive into the problem. What are we actually building and why does it matter?

process.title: Design
process.description: Wireframe, prototype, think through UX. No code until the plan is solid.

process.title: Build
process.description: Ship fast, iterate faster. Working software over perfect software — always.

process.title: Deploy
process.description: Production-ready. Monitored. Live. Not just a localhost demo that never ships.
